# cm021: divergences the patch does not record

## A brand or bulk mailbox with no list header is machine mail (CM051 F7, walk #16)

Tree `cm021`. NEW CM051-side behaviour. `src/cli.py` gains `automated_address_reason` and its constants (inserted immediately above the "An organisation writing from a personal-looking address" comment) and `automated_sender_reason` calls it last, after the list/bulk/auto-submitted headers, the local-part regex and the display-name rule. "Quidco" (`quidco@info.quidco.com`) and "HSBC Hong Kong" (`onlineservices@notification.hsbc.com.hk`) became People because their mail carried no list header this parser sees, and neither the local part nor the display name read as automated. The address does: a bulk-mail sub-domain (`info.`, `notification.`, `emails.`), a local part equal to the sender's own domain name, or an automation stem (`service`, `statement`, `noreply` ...). Existing reason labels are unchanged (the display-name rule still runs first).

### What a future sync must preserve

`automated_address_reason` and its call at the end of `automated_sender_reason`. Guarded by `tests/test_people_have_human_evidence.py` (`test_cm021_refuses_a_brand_mailbox_with_no_list_header`, `test_the_two_copies_of_the_address_rule_agree`) and the unchanged `tests/test_automated_senders_are_not_people.py`. Retire by landing the same change in CM021 and re-pinning.
